# A dusk moth, the treetops' hovering critter. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Moth --base-color 0.518 0.494 0.529 --no-slot
material new Wing --base-color 0.796 0.859 0.988 --no-slot
material new WingSpot --base-color 0.463 0.259 0.541 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --segments 8 --rings 5 --radius 0.5 --name Body --location 0 0 0
scale 0.17 0.4 0.18
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Moth
add mesh ico-sphere --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --name Head --location 0 -0.22 0.02
scale 0.14 0.12 0.13
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Moth
add mesh uv-sphere --segments 8 --rings 4 --radius 0.5 --name WingF --location 0 -0.08 0.2
scale 0.04 0.32 0.4
apply --scale
set rotation -18 0 0
apply --rotation
apply --location
material assign Wing
add mesh uv-sphere --segments 8 --rings 4 --radius 0.5 --name WingB --location 0 0.14 0.17
scale 0.04 0.28 0.32
apply --scale
set rotation 22 0 0
apply --rotation
apply --location
material assign Wing
add mesh cube --size 1 --name SpotF --location 0 -0.1 0.24
scale 0.07 0.1 0.1
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign WingSpot
add mesh cube --size 1 --name AntR --location -0.04 -0.31 0.1
scale 0.045 0.045 0.16
apply --scale
set rotation -35 0 0
apply --rotation
apply --location
material assign Moth
add mesh cube --size 1 --name AntL --location 0.04 -0.31 0.1
scale 0.045 0.045 0.16
apply --scale
set rotation -35 0 0
apply --rotation
apply --location
material assign Moth
select Body Head WingF WingB SpotF AntR AntL
active Body
join
rename Body Moth
select all
shade flat
export moth.glb
